findings.message: The fallback after `if (Shared)`, which renders a bare breadcrumb and h1, is dead code. Allocations has `dependsOn: ["delivery"]` and Delivery always fills `PROJECT_HEADER_SLOT` through `provides`, so the slot can't be empty while this page is mounted. If the branch ever did run (for example, slots not set at boot), it would drop the `actions` (the 'Ask amax · Add someone to <key>' button) and the tab bar without any sign. A related gap: when `ProjectHeaderFor` returns null (its `getProject` misses), the page renders the Team card with no h1, no tabs and no Ask button. Fix: delete the fallback. Treat a missing slot, or a null header, as the 'Project not found' page, not as a page without its header.
findings.scenario: Slot not provided, or the project is deleted or re-keyed between `teamFor` and the slot's `getProject` → the Team page shows the card with no heading and no 'Add someone' Ask amax control, and nothing says the header failed.

findings.message: This adds a second `initials()` beside Delivery's `initials` in `modules/delivery/ui/parts.ts`. The two can disagree: this one takes the first two words, so the same person can get different avatar letters on the Team row and on the board. Either use the same rule, or put it in `@amax/ui` in a separate platform change.
findings.scenario: A name with three words or a leading particle → the Team row's avatar can show different initials from the same person's avatar on the Delivery board.

findings.message: The table's PM chip matches on `manager.userId` even when `manager.inactive` is set. So a deactivated PM who still has allocations shows a 'PM' chip in the table, while the lead row says 'Account deactivated · needs a new PM'. Show the chip only for an active manager.
findings.scenario: The PM's account is deactivated and they still have allocations in the window → their table row says 'PM' while the highlighted row says the project needs a new PM.

findings.message: `actions` is always a Fragment, so `actions &&` in ProjectHeader is always true. An agent-first project with no sprint gets an empty `<div className="actions">` in its header row. Pass `undefined` when neither control renders.
findings.scenario: An agent-first project with a repo and no sprint → an empty .actions div sits in the header row.

findings.message: The new contract surface (`PROJECT_HEADER_SLOT` and `ProjectHeaderComponent`, which `ProjectHeaderFor` fills) has no contract test. No test checks that Delivery's manifest `provides` that key, or that the provided component renders the shared header for a section. Add one beside the existing slot tests.

`projectHeader` calls `getProject`, which loads every active proposal of the project and the closed-by counts, only to read the name, sprint and agent-first flag. Every tab now pays for that query on top of its own reads, and the Team page also runs it beside `teamFor`. Read only the project row and its environments.
